# Check — M0-c-01, the flat fixture and the S3 slice: closing check of @plat/layout's consolidation round R1 (lane check/M0-c-01-consolidate-close-1, 2026-10-12)

**Verdict: PASS.** Every line of the round was checked against the oracle the plan gives it, using this checker's own
evidence. The lines are 1.0.1, 1.0.2, 1.0.3 – 1.0.6, the comments of §2, the frozen API (J263 Q1) and NO-SHIFT (J260
(3)). No new finding is a blocker. The round changes no behaviour:

* A probe of the pre-round sources against the consolidated ones gives byte-identical output over 264 cases. The cases
  cover S3 slices (the registered seeds 1, 7 and 20251005, more flat seeds, small, river, tilted and limited sites),
  direct `gateRoutes` calls at six limits and six bearings, and 20 000 seeded `distToSegment` and `segmentMeetsRing`
  values.
* The base fixtures' model roots are byte-identical. `runBase` FLAT and RIVER at 900 / 30 ha, seeds 1 – 3, give the
  same five level digests, record text, S3 record, report hash and `bugs []`.
* The 92 pre-round test titles all stand among the 97 after the round. The pre-round test folder runs green on the
  consolidated sources (92 / 92).
* Every folder index and the barrel export the same runtime names: barrel 375, siting 35, fixtures 2. The file-level
  names added are exactly the plan's seven.
* 29 of 34 targeted mutants are red. These include every oracle mutant the plan names: K18, K27, K28, K34, K35, and
  L1 for 1.0.3. One survivor is equivalent (H1). The other four (X3, H13, H14, H15) also survive the pre-round sources
  and tests, so the round lost no kill. They go to the notes.

Every gate exits 0 and `landed:verify` is ok. Refusals stay at 0 → 0, re-measured below. RELATED@1000 has one red that
is not the item's: it is identical on the pre-round siting sources. Six notes rows (N-c1c-1 – N-c1c-6) are appended to
`checks/M0-c-01-notes.md`.

Seat: closing checker, independent of the author. The lane log was grepped first under the RESUME / CONTINUE rules and
had no line for this key. This checker planned its own probes and mutants (`zz-c1probe.test.ts`, `mutants.py`) before
it opened the builder's notes section, choices row C-0331 and CLEAN-ROOM row L-0458. Those are judged here and not used
as evidence. Machine: `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the J198 id. Node v24.12.0.
`tools/test_budget.py` printed 1 for workers and 1 for mutants. No timing was taken or gated on, and no git command was
run.

## Method

* **The before-image and its provenance.** No git could be run, and no landed record keeps the pre-round hashes,
  because the round re-landed `landed/M0-c-01.json`. The builder's copy `waves/before-M0-c-01/` (the item's 21 owned
  files, taken at 05:55 before its first edit) was therefore checked rather than trusted, in three ways:
  * Its `lattice.ts` has SHA-256 `4d61fec1…`. The closing checks `M0-c-01-s1.md` (l. 22 – 23, 125) and `M0-c-03-s1.md`
    (l. 25) quote that same hash for the post-S1 tree.
  * Every pre-round line number that the plan (written at 05:45 by another seat) cites matches the copy:
    * `lattice.ts:14` `const COS30` and `:48` `function boxOf`;
    * `geom.ts:17` `const CDEG_PER_RAD`;
    * `routes.ts:32` `class WorkLimitReached` and `:62` `function rimAtBearing`;
    * `slice.ts:40` `const HA_CM2`;
    * `levelset.ts:271` and `:287`, the two `pinIndices` calls.
  * `diff -rq` against the tree differs in exactly six sources (`geom`, `lattice`, `routes`, `slice`, `plaza`,
    `levelset`) and three tests (`lattice`, `gates`, `fwall`). Every hunk was read whole and is one of the plan's edits;
    see (1).
* **Mirrors.** These are this checker's own, under `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-c-01/`. Each is a copy of `plat/`
  without `node_modules` and the dists, with the vendored `simplex-noise` dist copied in, installed `--frozen-lockfile
  --offline` (exit 0), so `@plat/*` resolves inside the mirror.
  * `after`: the tree. `diff -rq` of `packages/layout` against the tree is empty.
  * `before`: the tree with the six sources and three tests replaced by the before-image.
  * Mutants ran in `after`, one at a time with `--maxWorkers=1 --bail=1`, each restored by copy. After each batch, every
    siting source was `cmp`-equal to the tree (`RESTORED ok`). The probe files lived only in the mirrors
    (`packages/layout/test/zz-c1probe/`). Both mirrors' `node_modules` were deleted at the end.
